correctness.rationale: The proof establishes the exact image criterion by run-count necessity and an explicit preimage constructed for every feasible output, including extra singleton padding. Counting by runs gives the complete finite histogram and a rational bivariate generating function. Deterministic-channel fiber selection establishes exact optimal zero-error cardinality. A uniformly isolated analytic dominant pole yields the capacity and quasi-power characteristic-function proof of the Gaussian length law with strictly positive variance. A direct program enumerated 79,087 source words and verified all claimed finite spectra for 34 parameter pairs; finite tests are not substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The first eligible-run threshold is a canonical endpoint of the contextual deletion model motivated by DNA nanopore synchronization errors. For every q-ary alphabet and every blocklength the theorem completely identifies possible observations, each output-length frequency, and the exact maximal zero-error code size. Its explicit nontrivial capacity and Gaussian output-length spectrum provide a sharp benchmark contrasting with the open nontrivial-threshold regime; they are not an arbitrary finite parameter slice or a mere numerical re-evaluation of a known table. It does not claim coding improvement at k>=2 or practical calibrated performance.
